prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "en stadion". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "stadium".
Scene: Wide view of oval sports stadium with football field and spectator tiers, one coherent field, no famous venue branding.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "stadion = stadium; a large sports ground with seating.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Matchen spelas på en stor stadion.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
